text: In all processes and transactions relating to the personal data of data subjects in Nigeria, it is a constitutional obligation to carefully consider the material scope and the territorial scope of the NDP Act vis-à-vis its objectives before a decision affecting the fundamental right to privacy is taken one way or the other.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Section 2(c) of the NDP Act applies to a data controller or data processor not domiciled in Nigeria but processes the personal data of a data subject in Nigeria or targets the personal data of data subjects in Nigeria. A data controller or data processor shall be cognisant of how domiciliation applies in Section 2 of the NDP Act. Sub-Articles 3 and 4 of this Article shall be relied upon for guidance when the right of a data subject and question of domiciliation of the data controller or data processor arises.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In line with the principle of universality of civil liberties, a natural person is entitled to the protection of his or her fundamental rights anywhere in the world. Accordingly, the categories of data subjects listed in Sub-Article 4 shall be entitled to the enjoyment of data subject rights under the NDP Act - subject only to the derogations permitted under the 1999 Constitution and any preemptory norm or international treaty applicable to Nigeria under International Law.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The categories of data subjects to whom Sub-Article 3 relates to are:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In order to guarantee certainty, harmony and efficacy on the regulation of: a) Informational self-determination (fundamental right to privacy); b) Data sovereignty (the inherent right of an independent country to govern data processing pertaining to persons in her territory); c) National and transborder data flows; and d) Treaty obligations (particularly in the material context highlighted in Article 2(b) of this NDP Act – GAID), it is imperative to uphold the provision of section 63 of the NDP Act in all proceedings and transactions pertaining to the processing of personal data. For ease of reference Section 63 of the NDP Act provides: "Where the provisions of any other law or enactment, in so far as they provide or relate directly or indirectly to the processing of personal data, are inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Act, the provisions of this Act shall prevail."
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In the event of a conflict between the NDP Act and this NDP Act-GAID, the NDP Act shall prevail.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Section 5(h) of the NDP Act mandates the Commission to collaborate with public authorities among others in order to achieve the objectives set forth in the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Without prejudice to the provisions of Section 63 of the NDP Act, the Commission shall cooperate with relevant public authorities in the development of sub-national or sectoral guidelines on data protection.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Commission shall conduct periodic reviews of sub-national or sectoral guidelines to determine whether such guidelines or instruments comply with the NDP Act, taking into account the provisions of Articles 1 & 2, of this NDP Act-GAID.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where the Commission determines that a guideline by a public authority relating to the processing of personal data negates the objectives of the NDP Act, it shall communicate its decisions to the public authority and it may in addition, request joint reviews with a view to developing a harmonious sub-national or sectoral guideline.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Commission shall take proactive steps in collaborating with public authorities and relevant institutions for the purposes of setting up Data Privacy Service Units and Centres of Excellence at sub-national, sectoral and organisational levels.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller, a data processor or an individual who relies on or intends to rely on any exemption pursuant to Section 3 of the NDP Act, shall abide by other provisions which are not exempted by the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Exemptions under the NDP Act apply to the obligations under Chapter V of the NDP Act apart from the sections mentioned in Sub-Article 2 of this Article. Thus, the Commission shall hold a data controller or data processor accountable for the infraction of any other provision of the NDP Act not covered by the exemption.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In exercise of its power under the NDP Act, and in carrying out an assessment of data processing activities exempted under Section 3 of the NDP Act, the Commission shall take into consideration:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In line with the provision of Section 3(1) of the NDP Act, an individual who processes data solely for personal or household purposes shall respect the privacy of a data subject and shall be held accountable for the conduct which puts the privacy of a data subject at risk.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Section 65 of the NDP Act provides, a "data controller or data processor of major importance" means a data controller or data processor that is domiciled, resident in, or operating in Nigeria and processes or intends to process personal data of more than such number of data subjects who are within Nigeria, as the Commission may prescribe, or such other class of data controller or data processor that is processing personal data of particular value or significance to the economy, society or security of Nigeria as the Commission may designate.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In line with Section 2 of the NDP Act "domiciled, resident in, or operating in Nigeria" means:

text: In assessing what is of value or significance to the economy, society or security of Nigeria, the Commission shall take into consideration all relevant factors – including but not limited to the following:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In order to ensure proportionality of obligations in relation to various levels of major data processing, the Commission classifies data controllers and data processors into 3 (three) levels or categories of data processing, namely:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: For direction on the factors taken into account by the Commission in determining what is of value or significance to the economy, society or security of Nigeria; and registration and fees by a data controller or a data processor of major importance, the Guidance Notice with reference number NDPC/HQ/GN/VOL.02/24 issued by the Commission and reproduced in this NDP Act-GAID as Schedule 4, shall be relied upon until such a time that the Commission amends or replaces the said Guidance Notice.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor of major importance as designated by the Commission shall register with the Commission in accordance with the Guidance Notice with reference number NDPC/HQ/GN/VOL.02/24 issued by the Commission and reproduced in this NDP Act-GAID as Schedule 4.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor in the category of Major Data Processing – Ultra High Level or Major Data Processing – Extra High Level shall register once and shall only be required to file CAR annually.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor in the category of Major Data Processing – Ordinary High Level shall renew its registration with the Commission on an annual basis and it shall not be required to file annual CAR.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or data processor of major importance shall notify the Commission of any significant change to the information submitted in its most recent registration submission within sixty (60) days after such change by providing any information required by the Commission through any electronic submission system provided by the Commission, or in the absence of which by email to an address provided by the Commission for such purpose.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: If a data controller or data processor no longer qualifies as a data controller or data processor of major importance, they may request removal from the register by providing the information required by the Commission through any electronic submission system provided by the Commission, or in the absence of which by email to an address that the Commission shall publish on its website.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Notwithstanding its removal from the register, a former data controller or data processor of major importance shall remain responsible for payment of any outstanding annual fees from the then-current and any prior annual registration periods.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Commission shall publish on its website the register of data controllers and data processors of major importance that have duly registered with it and shall update the register at least once annually.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor shall carry out periodic compliance audit of its data processing activities with a view to mitigating the risk of data breaches through appropriate technical and organisational measures.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In order to carry out an audit, a data controller or a data processor shall adopt a risk-based approach as may be associated with people, processes and technologies involved in its data processing value chain.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor shall develop or adopt privacy audit controls in line with global best practices. Each model of audit may comprise of a series of techniques ranging from simple to complex and technical to organisational.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or data processor shall identify each point of risk and determine the techniques and frequency of audit to be carried out on each point of risk subject to any directive by the Commission.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where personal data may be accessed from an online device of a data controller or data processor, such personal data is vulnerable to data security breaches. The audit of such online device shall be as frequently as possible.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or data processor of major importance shall file NDP Act Compliance Audit Returns (CAR) on an annual basis.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In the case of a data controller or a data processor of major importance that was established before the 12th day of June 2023, it shall file its CAR not later than the 31st of March each year.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In the case of a data controller or data processor of major importance established after the 12th day of June 2023, it shall file CAR not later than eighteen (18) months after its establishment and shall subsequently file its CAR annually.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where a data controller or data processor fails to file its CAR as and when due, it shall pay, in addition to the stipulated filing fee, an administrative penalty, which shall be 50% of the stipulated CAR filing fee.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: CAR filing fees are as follows:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where a CAR has been filed, the Commission may where necessary, direct that additional information be provided by a data controller or a data processor of major importance or by any person connected to the data processing under audit.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The annual filing of CAR as prescribed in Sub-Article 8 of this Article shall be carried out through an automated platform or portal provided by the Commission.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Except as otherwise approved by the Commission, a data controller or a data processor within the categories of a) Major Data Processing – Ultra High Level (MDP-UHL) b) Major Data Processing – Extra High Level (MDP-EHL) shall file CAR through a Data Protection Compliance Organisation (DPCO) licensed by the Commission.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Section 32 of the NDP Act mandates the designation of a DPO, accordingly, the DPO may be a staff member of the data controller, or fulfil the tasks on the basis of a service contract.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The data controller or the data processor shall publish the contact details of the DPO and communicate the same to the Commission in the prescribed form.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor shall actively engage its DPO in all issues which relate to the processing of personal data.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The data controller or data processor shall give appropriate support to the DPO in performing the data protection responsibilities as prescribed by the NDP Act or by the Commission. Accordingly, the data controller or data processor shall put in place the necessary organisational measures, namely:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The data controller or data processor shall ensure that the DPO does not carry out his or her task under duress, coercion, covert or overt influence.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: He or she shall not be dismissed or penalised by the data controller or the data processor for performing his or her tasks.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The DPO shall directly report to the management level of the controller or the processor.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Data subjects may contact the DPO with regard to all issues relating to the processing of their personal data and to the exercise of their rights under the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The DPO shall be bound by secrecy or confidentiality concerning the performance of his or her tasks, in accordance with relevant legislation.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The DPO may fulfil other tasks and duties. The data controller or data processor shall ensure that any such tasks and duties do not result in a conflict of interest.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor shall ensure that a semi-annual data protection report is compiled by its DPO and submitted to its management.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The report shall be submitted to an officer of the data controller or data processor who is authorised to receive a Record of Processing Activities (ROPA).
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The report shall be acknowledged by the receiving officer and shall form part of the ROPA by the data controller or data processor.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The report shall be verified by a DPCO during the NDP Act compliance audit.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The report to be submitted by the DPO shall among others, contain the compliance status of the data controller or data processor under the NDP Act – particularly taking into account:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Commission shall create a database of Certified DPOs who are designated by data controllers and data processors in furtherance of Section 32 of the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Commission shall carry out Annual Credential Assessment (ACA) of DPOs in order to ensure that each DPO maintains the level of professionalism required to carry out his or her responsibilities towards safeguarding the rights and interests of data subjects as required under the NDP Act, relevant case laws and any regulatory instrument issued by the Commission.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Pending the development of a Code of Conduct for DPOs, a DPO shall be guided by the provisions of the NDP Act, this NDP Act-GAID, the Code of Conduct for Data Protection Compliance Organisations (DPCOs) and any other relevant instrument issued by the Commission; thus, directives, codes or guidance relating to professionalism and ethics under these instruments shall apply to a DPO, with necessary modification, as if they were specifically directed at him or her.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Certification of a DPO shall be verified by the Commission as part of the Compliance Audit Returns prescribed by the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: verification scores or decline verification where the evidence wholly lacks credibility.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The fee for a DPO's credential assessment shall be N2,000 (Two thousand naira) annually.

text: A data controller or data processor shall assign relevant officers to carry out the tasks under the schedule and stipulate time to take appropriate technical and organisational measures under the schedule.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The schedule shall be vetted and certified by a duly certified information security officer.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Notwithstanding the schedule, a data controller shall carry out monitoring, evaluation and maintenance of data security systems as frequently as possible, taking into account the risks of data processing.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor shall prepare and implement an organisational schedule for internal sensitisation and training on privacy.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The schedule shall contain a mode of evaluating the level of compliance with the NDP Act, this NDP Act-GAID and other regulatory instruments issued by the Commission.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In respect of people, a data controller or data processor may adopt the use of meetings, questionnaires and interviews.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor shall publish the schedule on appropriate communication mediums where employees and other relevant workers, agents, and contractors, who are engaged in relevant activities may see it.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In order to enable persons engaged in data processing to understand their duties and responsibilities, a data controller shall develop a basic privacy checklist as a guide.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or data processor shall develop and implement a written policy for routine checks on compliance practices which may be carried out without notice to employees. This policy may be part of a larger data governance policy of the data controller or data processor.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor who (whether for itself or for other persons) deploys or intends to deploy data processing software for the purposes of tracking a data subject or enabling a communication link with a data subject and processing his or her personal data, is under an obligation to abide by the provisions of the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: For the purposes of complying with this NDP Act-GAID and in addition to other obligations imposed on a data controller or a data processor, it is mandatory for the data controller or data processor in the circumstances referred to in Article 32 (1) to:

source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller shall put in place, appropriate technical and organisational measures to prevent the use of its platform, facility, network or howsoever called, from being used to breach the privacy of a data subject.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: When the Commission notifies a data controller that its platform, facility, network or howsoever called is being used by any person to commit an offence under the NDP Act or to carry out a breach of privacy, the data controller shall immediately restrict such person on its platform, facility or network, pending the outcome of an investigation by the Commission.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In determining if a breach of privacy has occurred, the Commission shall only rely on credible documentary or electronic records.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where a data controller fails, refuses or neglects to carry out the directives of the Commission to prevent further breach of privacy, the data controller shall be deemed as abetting a breach of privacy and shall be accountable for violation of the NDP Act as if it directly committed a breach of data privacy.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The NDP Act under Section 40(2) provides that "a data controller shall, within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach which is likely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals, notify the Commission of the breach and, where feasible, describe the nature of the personal data breach including the categories and approximate numbers of data subjects and personal data records concerned."
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals if, considering the nature of the breach, the personal data involved as well as the probability of accessing other personal data of the data subject through the breach, the data subject may become a victim of fraud, identity theft or exposure of sensitive personal data.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In line with Section 40(2) of the NDP Act, a data controller shall notify affected data subjects immediately after becoming aware of the breach in order to ensure that data subjects are not unlawfully targeted as a result of the breach. This is in furtherance of the principle of duty of care and accountability.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Notwithstanding the time provided for the notification of a data breach, a data controller shall exercise a duty of care by providing immediate information on data breach to all relevant authorities including the Commission, if such immediate information may help in containing imminent data breaches on a national scale or containment measures may be necessary at national, sectoral or at an individual level or where it may affect members of the general public.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The content of a data breach notification to the Commission shall include the following among others:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In line with Section 29 of the NDP Act, a data processor is expected to rely on a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with the data controller in order to carry out data processing on behalf of the data controller.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In addition to other relevant terms and conditions, as may be prescribed by law, a DPA shall include the following:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A party to any DPA other than an individual data subject, shall take reasonable measures to ensure that the other party is compliant under the NDP Act, accountable to the Commission or, in the case of a foreign party, to a competent regulatory authority outside Nigeria; accordingly, every data controller or data processor shall be accountable for the actions or inactions of third parties it engages or permits to carry out data processing.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where a party to an agreement operates as a sole proprietorship, an individual agent or a self-employed worker, by reason of which he or she may not be organised to fulfil the obligations of corporate entities, such a person or individual shall for the purposes of his or her engagement in high-risk data processing, be required to be trained in data protection and privacy. Evidence of training and registration as a data processor of major importance shall be relied upon as a rebuttable proof of compliance with the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or data processor shall be cognisant of the need to advance data protection and privacy rights and the measures meticulously designed for this purpose in the globally interconnected and constantly evolving data protection ecosystem.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In the event that a data controller or data processor is to take a decision on an applicable technical and organisational measure for safeguarding data privacy rights, it is legally imperative to take into account the provisions of the extant Fundamental Rights Enforcement Procedure Rules in Nigeria on the importance of the municipal, regional and international bill of rights.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In furtherance of Article 36 (1), (2), a data controller or data processor may, subject to the approval of the Commission, benchmark its data processing with Interoperable Data Privacy Measures (IDPMs) in circumstances where a specific directive is required by the Commission under the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where a data controller intends to benchmark with an IDPM which expressly requires directives of the Commission under the NDP Act, it shall seek the approval of the Commission through an application stating the following:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In furtherance of Sections 5(i) and 62(a)(ii) of the NDP Act, the Commission may within thirty (30) days, issue an approval for the benchmarking of data processing with an IDPM if it is satisfied that the use of such IDPM is without prejudice to the provisions of the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: For the purposes of Article 35 (1) – (5), IDPM means best practice templates which are not limited by jurisdictional procedures and are particularly in furtherance of the globally interoperable principles of data protection as stipulated in Section 24 of the NDP Act. Accordingly, instances where IDPM may be used include but are not limited to:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Without prejudice to the provisions of the NDP Act and any regulatory instrument issued by the Commission, a DPO is required to consider suitable IDPMs which may be used by a data controller or a data processor as part of global best practices in data processing. Accordingly, it is appropriate for a DPO to proactively review IDPMs prior to when the need for them arises. The Commission shall continuously provide guidance on IDPMs.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The right to data rectification is essential to the operation of the principle of data accuracy under the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The data controller shall ensure that the platforms through which it processes personal data also provide an effective opportunity for data rectification.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Data rectification may not depend on the provision of an affidavit or a publication in a newspaper provided that the rectification is to bring the data into alignment with the personal data relating to the data subject's National Identification Number (NIN).
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where data rectification is for the purpose of correcting an error made by the data controller or data processor in inputting the personal data of the data subject, the data subject shall not be required to pay in order to correct an error which is not his or her fault. Accordingly, it is important to ensure that the data subject is provided with manifestly ample opportunity to verify his or her data before such data is submitted in a permanent format.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Whenever there is a dispute as to whether a data subject was provided with manifestly ample opportunity to verify his or her personal data before being submitted in a permanent format, the data controller shall provide the evidence of the manifestly ample opportunity. Accordingly, data processing platforms together with the technical and organisational measures for their operations shall be designed in a way that may allow the data controller to audit any source of error.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data subject has a right to data portability.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The right to data portability shall apply where the data subject provided the personal data on the basis of his or her consent or the processing is necessary for the performance of a contract. It may not apply where processing is based on a legal ground other than consent or contract.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The right to data portability may not apply against a data controller in the performance of their public duties; unless there is a compelling legitimate interest or right of a data subject that may be abridged by reason of denying the data subject's right of data portability.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where, in a certain set of personal data, more than one data subject is concerned, the right to receive the personal data should be without prejudice to the rights and freedoms of other data subjects in accordance with the NDP Act or any regulatory instrument issued by the Commission.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The right to data portability shall not prejudice the right of the data subject to obtain the erasure of personal data and the limitations of that right as prescribed under the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Nothing in this Article shall imply the erasure of personal data concerning the data subject which has been provided by him or her for the performance of a contract to the extent that and for as long as are necessary for the performance of that contract.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data subject has the right to have his or her personal data erased if:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: However, an organisation's interest in processing the personal data may override a data subject's right to be forgotten if:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Without prejudice to the provisions of the NDP Act, where a data controller has made personal data public or has shared data with third parties, the data controller is under obligation to ensure the erasure of such personal data by the third parties at the request of the data subject or in compliance with the directives of the Commission in that regard.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: This right may not apply where there is a public interest pursued by disclosure of the data to the general public – provided that the burden of proving the existence of a public interest shall be on the data controller who intends to keep the personal data public.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The right to lodge a complaint with the Commission shall be deemed as a threshold right of redress in furtherance of the right to privacy under Section 37 of the 1999 Constitution and Section 46 of the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Every regulation, policy, framework, or legal instrument which pertains to the processing of personal data shall in addition to all applicable data subject rights contain a clause on the right to lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Commission may set up an electronic platform through which a data subject may lodge his or her complaint with the Commission and it shall acknowledge the receipt of the complaint within seven (7) days, provided that the Commission shall continue to receive complaints by any reasonable means through which it may be contacted by a complainant (including but not limited to hard copies at its known offices and emails).
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where a complaint is received on any platform other than through a designated complaint platform or through a hard copy duly delivered to its known offices, the Commission may only acknowledge as soon as possible, taking into consideration the number of unrelated information that may be undergoing processing on such platforms.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Upon the receipt of a complaint in line with Section 46 of the NDP Act, the Commission shall carry out a preliminary evaluation of the complaint – taking into account:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where the Commission is convinced through a preliminary evaluation that there is a violation of the NDP Act, it shall open a case file for the complaint.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Upon the opening of a case file, the Commission shall immediately serve the affected data controller or data processor (hereafter referred to as the respondent) a notice of investigation.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The notice of investigation may require the respondent to provide, where applicable:
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The respondent shall, except as otherwise specified by the Commission, reply the Commission within twenty-one (21) days.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: If the Commission deems it appropriate, it shall invite the respondent to a Pre-Action Conference (PAC) in order to examine the facts and the available evidence provided by the parties or obtained by the Commission through investigation.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: PACs may take place as frequently as necessary in respect of a complaint or an investigation carried out by the Commission pursuant to Section 46(3) of the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In line with the power vested in the Commission under Section 6(e) of the NDP Act, the Commission may direct a data controller to attend a PAC with any relevant person who is legally compellable or competent to give evidence and who may provide relevant information in determining an issue relating to violation of the NDP Act.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Where the Commission is satisfied that a violation of the NDP Act has taken place, it shall direct appropriate remedial action to be taken by the respondent as prescribed by the NDP Act and shall communicate its decision to the complainant and to the affected parties within forty-five (45) days of holding a final PAC.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Nothing in this NDP Act-GAID shall prevent the Commission from issuing a temporary order on such terms and conditions as it deems fit in the interest of protecting the privacy right of a data subject – particularly when the violation of a data privacy right may not be remedied properly through compensation.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In line with the power vested in the Commission to, among others, make regulations for the protection of personal data and data subjects under section 61(1)-(2)(b) of the NDP Act, the Commission may promote the use of Data Subject's Standard Notice to Address Grievance (SNAG).
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: An aggrieved data subject may issue a SNAG to a data controller or a data processor where the data subject reasonably believes that the data controller or data processor violated his or her right to data privacy.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: SNAG shall not be regarded as a condition precedent for lodging a direct complaint with the Commission or for instituting an action, rather it shall be regarded as a standardised template for demanding internal remediation in an organisation which may be acting in violation of a data subject's privacy.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: SNAG may be served directly by a data subject or by a person acting under his or her authority or by a civil society organisation acting in the public interest.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Commission may create an electronic platform through which it may track SNAGs.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Upon receipt of a SNAG, a data controller or a data processor shall communicate its decision on the SNAG to the Commission through the designated electronic platform.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The Commission may take executive notice of SNAGs and institute direct investigation into the service of a SNAG on a data controller or a data processor particularly when such SNAG appears to be unresolved.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A SNAG may be served on a data controller or a data processor via its physical address, telephone messaging medium, e-mail address, courier service or other reasonable means of correspondence.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: A data controller or a data processor shall prioritise the principles of data ethics which offer additional safeguards to the privacy and dignity of the human person.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: To fortify the principles of the sanctity of personal information and the preservation of human dignity, both data controllers and data processors must steadfastly adhere to the tenets of data ethics.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Data ethics, as enshrined in this Article, serves as an indispensable guide, elevating the standards of safeguarding individuals' privacy and upholding their inherent dignity. This entails a commitment to transparency, fairness, and responsible data management practices.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Transparency forms the bedrock of ethical data handling. Data controllers and processors must furnish individuals with clear and comprehensible information regarding the collection, processing, and storage of their data. This ensures that individuals are well-informed, empowering them to make informed decisions about their personal information.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Fairness in data processing underscores the commitment to impartiality and equity. Discrimination based on gender, ethnicity, religion, physical ability or any other characteristic is strictly prohibited. Every individual is entitled to equal protection, fostering an inclusive digital landscape.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Responsible data management involves the implementation of robust security measures to protect against unauthorised access, breaches, or any form of misuse. It requires the continuous evaluation and enhancement of data protection protocols to adapt to evolving technological landscapes.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Emphasising the dignity of the human person, data controllers and processors must acknowledge the intrinsic value of every individual's data. The extraction, processing, or utilisation of data must not compromise the autonomy, freedom, or integrity of any person.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Any data collection or processing that may result in harm, discrimination, or violation of individual rights is strictly prohibited. Safeguards should be in place to prevent the creation of profiles or the application of algorithms that could lead to prejudiced outcomes.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: In cases where data is shared with third parties, explicit consent must be obtained from the data subject. The purpose, scope, and duration of such data sharing must be clearly communicated, and individuals should retain the right to revoke consent at any time.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: Continuous education and awareness programs should be implemented to keep individuals informed about their digital rights, empowering them to exercise control over their personal data.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)

text: The principles outlined in this article reflect a commitment to building a digital ecosystem that respects the fundamental rights of individuals. By prioritising data ethics, we aim to create a responsible and trustworthy digital environment that values and protects the privacy and dignity of every human person.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDP Act) 2023 General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2024, ref. NDPC/NDP ACT-GAID/001/2024 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria-Data-Protection-Act(NDP ACT)2023(GAID)2024.pdf)
